defmodule PaymentCrypto do
  @moduledoc """
  Payment signature verification library for Kubernetes-deployed payment gateway.
  Uses HMAC-SHA256 for transaction integrity verification.
  """

  @enforce_keys [:merchant_id, :amount_cents, :currency, :nonce, :timestamp]
  defstruct [:merchant_id, :amount_cents, :currency, :nonce, :timestamp, :metadata]

  @max_timestamp_drift_ms 30_000
  @supported_currencies ~w(USD EUR GBP JPY)

  def verify_and_process(payload, signature, secret_key) do
    with {:ok, transaction} <- parse_transaction(payload),
         :ok <- validate_timestamp(transaction),
         :ok <- validate_currency(transaction),
         :ok <- validate_amount(transaction),
         :ok <- verify_signature(payload, signature, secret_key) do
      {:ok, apply_pricing_rules(transaction)}
    end
  end

  defp parse_transaction(payload) when is_map(payload) do
    try do
      tx = %__MODULE__{
        merchant_id: Map.fetch!(payload, "merchant_id"),
        amount_cents: Map.fetch!(payload, "amount_cents"),
        currency: Map.fetch!(payload, "currency"),
        nonce: Map.fetch!(payload, "nonce"),
        timestamp: Map.fetch!(payload, "timestamp"),
        metadata: Map.get(payload, "metadata", %{})
      }
      {:ok, tx}
    rescue
      KeyError -> {:error, :missing_required_field}
    end
  end
  defp parse_transaction(_), do: {:error, :invalid_payload}

  defp validate_timestamp(%__MODULE__{timestamp: ts}) do
    now = System.system_time(:millisecond)
    if abs(now - ts) <= @max_timestamp_drift_ms do
      :ok
    else
      {:error, :timestamp_expired}
    end
  end

  defp validate_currency(%__MODULE__{currency: currency}) do
    if currency in @supported_currencies, do: :ok, else: {:error, :unsupported_currency}
  end

  defp validate_amount(%__MODULE__{amount_cents: amount}) when is_integer(amount) and amount > 0 do
    :ok
  end
  defp validate_amount(_), do: {:error, :invalid_amount}

  defp verify_signature(payload, signature, secret_key) do
    canonical = canonicalize_payload(payload)
    expected = compute_hmac(canonical, secret_key)
    if signatures_equal?(expected, signature) do
      :ok
    else
      {:error, :invalid_signature}
    end
  end

  defp canonicalize_payload(payload) when is_map(payload) do
    payload
    |> Enum.sort_by(fn {k, _v} -> k end)
    |> Enum.map(fn {k, v} -> "#{k}=#{encode_value(v)}" end)
    |> Enum.join("&")
  end

  defp encode_value(v) when is_map(v), do: Jason.encode!(v)
  defp encode_value(v), do: to_string(v)

  defp compute_hmac(data, key) do
    :crypto.mac(:hmac, :sha256, key, data)
    |> Base.encode16(case: :lower)
  end

  defp signatures_equal?(a, b) when byte_size(a) != byte_size(b), do: false
  defp signatures_equal?(a, b) do
    a_bytes = :binary.bin_to_list(a)
    b_bytes = :binary.bin_to_list(b)
    compare_bytes(a_bytes, b_bytes, 0)
  end

  defp compare_bytes([], [], acc), do: acc == 0
  defp compare_bytes([h1 | t1], [h2 | t2], acc) do
    compare_bytes(t1, t2, Bitwise.bor(acc, Bitwise.bxor(h1, h2)))
  end

  # Business logic: apply tiered pricing based on transaction amount
  defp apply_pricing_rules(%__MODULE__{amount_cents: amount, currency: currency} = tx) do
    fee_cents = calculate_fee(amount, currency)
    %{transaction: tx, fee_cents: fee_cents, net_amount_cents: amount - fee_cents}
  end

  defp calculate_fee(amount_cents, currency) do
    base_rate = currency_rate(currency)
    tier_multiplier = tier_for_amount(amount_cents)
    # Fee calculation: amount * rate * tier_multiplier
    # Using integer arithmetic to avoid floating point
    trunc(amount_cents * base_rate * tier_multiplier)
  end

  defp currency_rate("USD"), do: 0.029
  defp currency_rate("EUR"), do: 0.025
  defp currency_rate("GBP"), do: 0.027
  defp currency_rate("JPY"), do: 0.032

  # Tier multiplier reduces fee percentage for larger transactions
  defp tier_for_amount(amount) when amount < 1_000, do: 1.5
  defp tier_for_amount(amount) when amount < 10_000, do: 1.0
  defp tier_for_amount(amount) when amount < 100_000, do: 0.8
  defp tier_for_amount(_amount), do: 0.6

  # Kubernetes health check endpoint data
  def health_check do
    %{
      status: :healthy,
      crypto_available: Code.ensure_loaded?(:crypto),
      timestamp: System.system_time(:millisecond)
    }
  end

  # Idempotency check using nonce registry (GenServer-backed in production)
  def check_idempotency(nonce, registry_pid) do
    case GenServer.call(registry_pid, {:check_nonce, nonce}) do
      :new -> :ok
      :seen -> {:error, :duplicate_nonce}
    end
  end
end

defmodule PaymentCrypto.NonceRegistry do
  use GenServer

  def start_link(opts \\ []) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, %{}, opts)
  end

  @impl true
  def init(state), do: {:ok, state}

  @impl true
  def handle_call({:check_nonce, nonce}, _from, state) do
    if Map.has_key?(state, nonce) do
      {:reply, :seen, state}
    else
      {:reply, :new, Map.put(state, nonce, System.system_time(:millisecond))}
    end
  end
end
